title: How to keep enjoying programming in a world of LLMs
summary: A Hacker News discussion (259 points, 292 comments) linking to a Haskell Discourse article about maintaining enjoyment of programming amid widespread LLM adoption. The piece and community responses explore how developers can preserve craft, curiosity, and satisfaction when AI tools increasingly automate coding tasks, touching on workflow changes, skill erosion concerns, and strategies for meaningful human-AI collaboration.
